scope: Named skeletal muscles, selected serial muscle groups and common composite muscles in the TA2 muscular-system vocabulary. Both sexes and listed inconstant structures are tracked separately. This flat checklist is a coverage baseline, not a universal muscle count, a verbatim TA2 hierarchy, or geometric validation.
terminologySource: FIPAT. Terminologia Anatomica, 2nd ed., 2019; individual terms. Source-model index checked alongside independent OpenStax regional anatomy.

items.name: Puborectalis
items.note: Pelvic-floor nomenclature varies. Do not equate puboanalis with puborectalis automatically. Verify the anorectal sling and origin-insertion relationships.

scopeExclusions: Microscopic smooth-muscle layers and cardiomyocytes are taught in Chapter 10 but are not supplied by this skeletal-muscle model layer.

Visceral smooth muscles, intrinsic ocular smooth muscles, cardiac muscular structures, anatomical variants beyond this finite checklist, precise attachment footprints and every regional fascicle require separate scope and review.
The source terminology CSV is a convenience index, not an independent anatomical authority. The checklist is not a certified transcription of every TA2 term.
